item.title: Ant brains show how hunger circuits evolved into parenting behavior
item.description: Research on clonal raider ants suggests that parenting may have evolved from brain systems originally linked to hunger, with two chemical signals driving the shift.

item.title: Extreme magma heat may drive towering lava fountains
item.description: Analysis of magma from the 2021 Tajogaite eruption on La Palma indicates that extreme heat can significantly alter eruption dynamics, potentially fueling tall lava fountains.

item.title: Primordial black holes could trigger supernova explosions in white dwarfs
item.description: Researchers suggest that tiny black holes passing through white dwarf stars might cause them to explode as Type Ia supernovae, potentially explaining some cosmic events.

item.title: NASA's Curiosity rover discovers honeycomb-like terrain on Mars
item.description: The rover has entered a valley filled with small polygonal fractures resembling a honeycomb, each measuring only a few centimeters across.
